chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Qāsim ibn ʿUrwah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, concerning tayammum.
He عليه السلام said: You strike the earth with your two palms, then shake them off, and wipe your face and your two hands with them.

key_terms.التَّيَمُّمِ: dry ablution performed as a substitute for wudu (ablution) or ghusl (ritual bath) in certain conditions
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth or ground used for tayammum

ai.seo_question: How is tayammum performed according to the hadith of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the method of tayammum as taught by Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام. It establishes that one strikes the earth with both palms, shakes them off, and then wipes the face and hands, indicating a practical legal ruling for ritual purification when tayammum is required.
